subject: OrchestraAI launch — tri-region dedicated capacity ask
messages:
From: Sandra Ortiz <sandra@orchestra.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@orchestra.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Launch capacity ask — US/EU/APAC committed pools

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — OrchestraAI is targeting a staged launch in Q4 and we need a committed, tri-region plan so we can finalize pricing and our go-live runbooks. High-level requirements below:

- Expected steady-state: ~3M generated tokens/day across all regions (mix weighted 60% US / 30% EU / 10% APAC)
- Peak concurrent requests: ~120 qps globally (regional peaks may hit ~80 qps)
- Latency SLO: p50 < 200ms for long-form generation (avg seq 600 tokens), p95 < 600ms
- Model: running a 13B open model family with Redwood-verified optimized kernels; willing to consider quantized variants if that eases commit.
- Security: SOC2 + VPC peering required for EU and APAC; will need audit log retention for 13 months.
- Timeline: trial in US by 2025-09-15; full tri-region production by 2025-11-01.

Can you send a suggested committed GPU pool split (by region and H100-equivalent), burst/backstop plan, and timeline with rough pricing so procurement can budget? I attached our traffic projections and a short runbook.

Also flag anything we should scope as Private deployment vs Dedicated.

Appreciate it — Sandra

--
Sandra Ortiz
Head of Platform
OrchestraAI
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>

Subject: Fwd: Launch capacity ask — US/EU/APAC committed pools

Team — forwarding Orchestra's ask. Key constraints: 60/30/10 traffic split, steady-state ~3M tokens/day, peak ~120 qps, timeline: US pilot 2025-09-15, tri-region prod 2025-11-01. They want committed sizing + burst/backstop and a price placeholder for procurement.

Please propose a triage: committed H100-equivalent per region, recommended burst lanes (fraction of commit) and any private/VPC requirements for EU/APAC. Also call out any lead times we should surface (hardware orders vs cloud reservations).

I attached our internal capacity template and asked for an initial SOW. Can we get a draft by EOD Monday? I'll loop legal once we have numbers.

Thanks — Vanessa

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 May 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Launch capacity ask — US/EU/APAC committed pools

Vanessa / team — initial sizing notes and assumptions below (high level). I dug into their projection file and converted token load into sustained RPS by region using 600-token sequences.

Assumptions:
- Average sequence length: 600 tokens
- Generation token throughput per GPU (H100-eq): ~1200 tokens/sec for 13B optimized path at our perf configs
- Effective sustained tokens/day per H100-eq: 103.7M tokens/day (1200 t/s * 86,400 s) — conservative for sustained workloads

Sizing (steady-state):
- Global steady tokens/day: 3,000,000 -> sustained tokens/sec ~34.7 t/s global -> but spikes matter.
- Using their 60/30/10 split gives regional steady tokens/day: US 1.8M, EU 0.9M, APAC 0.3M (note: their projections have burst days at 3x steady).

Prelim committed pool (H100-equivalent):
- US: 8 H100-eq committed (covers steady and operational buffer)
- EU: 4 H100-eq committed
- APAC: 2 H100-eq committed

Burst strategy / backstop (deal-affinity):
- Short-term burst lanes: allow 2x committed in each region via on-demand burst (policy + pricing higher).
- Global emergency backstop: additional 12 H100-eq pooled across regions for the first 90 days (to handle 3x traffic days during launch).

SLA note: To hit p95 under heavy batching we should advise model quantization to int8 in EU/APAC for cost predictability; will surface quality tradeoffs in the SOW.

Lead times:
- Reserved capacity allocation internal config: 1-2 weeks once contract signed and commit accepted.
- If ordering additional physical racks / new infra sizing for APAC private region (air-gapped): 8-12 weeks — call out as a separate line item.

I'll attach a spreadsheet with token math and two scenario decks (conservative / aggressive). Questions:
- Do they want a single committed SKU per region or split between low-latency and high-throughput pools?
- Confirm if EU region requires on-prem package or just VPC peering + data residency SLA.

Ben

Attachments: capacity-rundown.xlsx

--
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 510-555-0187
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Sandra Ortiz <sandra@orchestra.ai>
Cc: Tom Lee <tom.lee@orchestra.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 May 2025 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Proposed tri-region commit and next steps (OrchestraAI)

Hi Sandra (and Tom),

Thanks for the projection — attached is our recommendation for a committed + burst configuration that balances launch predictability with a modest burst buffer for marketing-driven spikes. High level:

Summary proposal (H100-equivalent):
- US committed: 8 H100-eq (covers steady-state + operational buffer)
- EU committed: 4 H100-eq
- APAC committed: 2 H100-eq
- Short-term pooled burst/backstop: 12 H100-eq available for the first 90 days (global pool to be activated by policy)

Burst policy:
- Regional burst up to 2x committed via on-demand pricing tiers (auto-activated by policy when SLOs risk falling below agreed thresholds)
- Emergency global backstop billed monthly as a capacity reservation line item; will only be used with both parties' approval.

SLOs & quality tradeoffs:
- We expect p50 latency <200ms in steady-state with the suggested split. Under burst, p95 may increase unless you accept model quantization (int8) in EU/APAC; we recommend a canary quantized variant during ramp to validate quality.

Compliance & deployment notes:
- EU: VPC peering + data residency controls are available in Frankfurt region; if you need an on-prem package (air-gapped), lead time ~10 weeks and additional platform licensing applies.
- Audit log retention: we can meet 13-month retention with the compliance add-on.

Timeline:
- Sign SOW & commit: target by 2025-07-01
- US pilot activation: 2025-09-15
- Tri-region production: 2025-11-01 (assuming no on-prem hardware ordering; add 8-12 weeks otherwise)

Next steps:
1) If this sizing looks reasonable, we'll share a draft SOW (DocuSign link below) and a cost placeholder for procurement.
2) Technical kickoff with Ben/Karthik to lock down punch-list and VPC peering details.
3) Decide on quantization canary window.

DocuSign SOW (placeholder): https://www.docusign.com/link/ORB-2025-0412-SOW
Drive folder with math & scenarios: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1xYzOrchCapacityPlanning
HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/deal/ORB-2025-0412

If that alignment looks good, please reply with approval to move to SOW. Happy to hop on a 30m call this week if you prefer.

Best,
Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0142
